title: Resolve Energia Global International's former registered office and headquarters semantics
summary: Recover authoritative historical Bermuda corporate records or contemporaneous first-party filings that distinguish registered office, headquarters, principal office, and operating locations for Energia Global International, Ltd.

sources.title: Energia Global International, Ltd. | ICIJ Offshore Leaks Database

data.target: Energia Global International former registered office and headquarters semantics
data.query: Energia Global International Ltd Bermuda registered office headquarters Appleby 1997 2012
data.research_question: What exact public business address, if any, served as Energia Global International's registered office or headquarters during its corporate life, and how did those location roles change before closure in 2012?
objectives: Recover a historical Bermuda registry extract, Gazette notice, Appleby record, annual report, or contemporaneous company filing with an exact public business address.
Distinguish registered office, headquarters, principal office, project locations, and incorporation jurisdiction.
Preserve temporal validity and do not infer a street address from Bermuda registration alone.
preferred_sources: Bermuda Registrar of Companies historical records
contemporaneous company filings or annual reports
selection_reason: The existing Paradise Papers organization record names Bermuda as jurisdiction but lacks a typed location edge.
Current public evidence establishes historical Bermuda registration but not an exact registered office or headquarters.
The entity is historical/closed, so current operating-address inference would be misleading.
